subject: Luis Figo
title: Figo's 2-2 Clasico prediction

lines.vo: Luis Figo called a two-two Clasico. Reality disagreed.
lines.footage: Figo studio clip, then Clasico scoreboard graphic

lines.vo: He named four scorers: Raphinha, Yamal, Bellingham and Mbappe.
Real Madrid won two-one. Mbappe scored twice, Raphinha once.
Only two of his four scorers found the net. Half right.
Back then, he says, he could have started for either team. That was twenty-six years ago.
To be fair, he won the 2000 Ballon d'Or. Football he gets. Forecasts, less so.
He also said Mourinho could have been a good Barcelona coach. Bold, Luis. Very bold.

facts_used: Figo predicted a 2-2 Clasico at Camp Nou with goals from Raphinha, Lamine Yamal, Bellingham and Mbappe; he said that at his level 26 years ago he could have started for either team (https://www.libertaddigital.com/deportes/liga/2026-10-22/figo-analiza-el-clasico-el-real-madrid-seguramente-tendra-opciones-a-la-contra-7480547/)
Real Madrid won 2-1 at Camp Nou on 25 Oct 2026; Mbappe scored twice, Raphinha equalised; Yamal and Bellingham did not score (https://www.101greatgoals.com/?p=219286)
Figo said Mourinho could have been a good Barcelona coach (libertaddigital source above)
notes: Clasico facts checked against two sources. The 'could have started' quote is attributed to Figo's own words and is not presented as a current claim. The Mourinho line is a documented remark, not a personal attack. Figo's age, politics and Betfair role are not used. after_line counts from 1. Punch-up pass: 'half right' and 'forecasts, less so' tease the prediction only. Line order changed so the 'could have started' remark lands as the excuse. 'Twenty-six years ago' comes from the same Figo interview.
